title: Oak lounge chair in snow light

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The oak lounge chair stands in three-quarter view beside a floor-to-ceiling window in a bright timber cabin, snow falling on the pines outside in soft white morning light, a sheepskin on the pale floor beside it. Its pale natural oak frame keeps the flat, wide paddle-shaped armrests with rounded ends and the square-section legs of its product photos, under thick cream boucle cushions. 35mm at seat height from the front and to one side, the whole chair in frame.
